name: Distribución de Entropía
useCase: Detecting AI text through entropía uniformity análisis
mechanism: Calcula sliding-window entropía a través de the content and analiza the distribución varianza. AI text typically shows more uniform entropía distribución compared to escritura humana.
source: Gehrmann et al. (2019) - GLTR: Statistical Detection of Generated Text
parameters: Tamaño de ventana: adaptativo, Quantization: 8-64 levels, Metrics: entropía, CV, correlación
strengths:
- Effective for detecting generado por IA text
- Language-agnostic estadístico approach
- Works with any text length
- Low computational overhead
limitations:
- Less effective on edited or paraphrased AI text
- Domain-specific content may trigger falsos positivos
- Short texts provide less reliable signals
- Performance varies a través de estilo de escrituras

references.title: Gehrmann et al. (2019) - GLTR: Statistical Detection of Generated Text
Solaiman, I. et al. (2019). Release Strategies and the Social Impacts of Language Models. OpenAI Technical Report.
Mitchell, E. et al. (2023). DetectGPT: Zero-Shot Machine-Generated Text Detection using Probability Curvature. ICML.
